I’m using the repository’s `crimes-codebase-risk` review guidance to keep the merge decision aligned with the scanner’s intended severity and risk semantics. I’ll classify every one of the 37 reported findings (noting the skipped ID is just numbering).

I’d block the merge on all four new high-severity findings. Medium findings become warnings; low findings normally do not gate, except the two with `agent_risk ≥ 0.50`, which deserve explicit review.

“ignore” below means “do not gate this merge,” not “never fix.”

| ID | Finding | Severity | Agent risk | Justification |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
